title: CI: lore gates and tracker integrity on dev
description: Delivers the repo half of opum-agent OPAG-835, glyph-cli's fleet onboarding: a workflow whose checks can be made required on the gated ref (dev). Jobs: Docs (lore validate --strict, lore check --strict, lore agents --check) and Tracker integrity (the Quest version derived from the CLAUDE.md managed block, tracker reads cleanly, managed instructions current). There is no Check job yet because the repository has no code. Third-party actions pinned to full commit SHAs verified against their upstream tags. Runs on the fleet's [self-hosted, Linux, ARM64] label, which has to be shown to actually serve this private repository. Making the checks required is a ruleset step that follows, only after they report green on dev.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Both CI jobs run on a glyph-cli pull request on [self-hosted, Linux, ARM64] runners and report green on a clean tree, with the runner names recorded

A deliberate violation turns the matching job red with its own error: a broken cross-link fails Docs with a lore bundle error, and Tracker integrity stays green on the same SHA, so the gate moved for its own reason and not because something general broke
Every third-party action is pinned to a full commit SHA, verified against its upstream tag
The run records the lore and quest versions it resolved, not only its exit codes

plan: 1. Write .github/workflows/ci.yml with Docs and Tracker integrity jobs, every third-party action pinned to a SHA verified against its upstream tag
2. Land it on dev through a pull request off origin/dev; confirm both jobs green on the pushed SHA and record the runner names the jobs actually resolved
3. Prove the gate rejects as well as accepts: a deliberate broken cross-link turns Docs red with a lore bundle error while Tracker integrity stays green on the same SHA
4. After the checks report green on dev, add the ruleset making both required, and record the measured ruleset id, gated ref, required contexts and bypass actors in CLAUDE.md repository profile
implementationNotes: dev bootstrap, 2026-09-29: created refs/heads/dev at 253e6315c02b8bf98cd9d4c9eb914531adb0c6b4 via gh api -X POST repos/opum-ai/glyph-cli/git/refs (ref=refs/heads/dev, sha=253e6315c02b8bf98cd9d4c9eb914531adb0c6b4), run bare as its own call. This is the ONE deliberate trunk write for this repository. It was written directly rather than through a pull request because a repository with no dev branch cannot receive a pull request against dev: the opum-workflow 0.11.2 guard-trunk-writes.sh hook refuses any push whose destination is dev, and its own text asks for an uncovered case to be named and done deliberately rather than worked around. Ruling: opum-agent, OPAG-835, 2026-09-29, on the ground that the SHA equals the origin/main tip and so carries no content main does not already have; both refs were read back at that SHA after the POST. From here nothing reaches dev except by pull-request squash, beginning with this task.
